description: Render a Home Assistant template (Jinja) with its own states and helpers, for what no other tool answers in one call: "{{ states.light | selectattr('state', 'eq', 'on') | map(attribute='entity_id') | list }}", "{{ area_entities('kitchen') }}", "{{ now() }}". Rendering changes nothing. Home Assistant renders templates only for administrators: with another user's token this answers needs_admin without asking Home Assistant (health says which it is).

variables.description: Variables the template can use by name.

name: render_template
title: Render a template
